footerTagline: Muna gina fasaha da ke haɗa mutane tare da fifita sirri da tsaro.
heroDescription: Muna ƙirƙirar manhajojin Android masu amfani tare da binciken sabbin dabaru a fannin basirar wucin gadi, sirri da tsaro domin gina fasahar da ke fifita mutane.
heroCommitmentLine: Amfani a ƙira. Sirri a matsayin ƙa'ida.
journeyTitle: Bayanan ka. Zaɓin ka. Ikon ka.
journeyIntro: Sauƙaƙƙen bayani kan haɗarin sirri da mutane za su iya fuskanta a yanar gizo da kuma hanyar da ke fifita sirri da muke bincika tare da SafeMobile.
journeyStep1Text: Idan ka yi amfani da manhaja ko sabis, bayanai na iya wucewa ta hanyoyin sadarwa da ayyuka daban-daban.
journeyStep2Text: Masu sa ido na wasu ɓangarori da fasahar ƙirƙirar bayanan martaba na iya lura da aiki a manhajoji da gidajen yanar gizo.
journeyStep3Text: Muna binciken ƙwarewar SafeMobile da za ta taimaka wajen gano da dakatar da ayyukan da ake zargi. Har yanzu ba a fitar da ita ba.
journeyStep4Text: Zaɓuɓɓuka bayyanannu, saitunan farko masu mutunta sirri, da sarrafawa a bayyane ya kamata su ba mutane damar yanke shawara.
journeyFootnote: Wannan tafiyar sirri misali ce kawai; ba ta bayyana fasalin kariyar SafeMobile da aka saki a yanzu ba.
aboutDescription: Muna gina kayayyakin dijital masu amfani tare da binciken fasahar da ke da alhaki, muna bai wa mutane kayan aikin da suke buƙata tare da fifita sirri da tsaro.
productsDescription: Tarin kayan aikin dijital masu kyau da ke ƙaruwa, daga kayan aikin Android na yau da kullum zuwa ayyukan bincike kan sirri da tsaro.
safeEyebrow: Ana haɓakawa · Nan ba da jimawa ba
safeTitle: Ƙwarewar wayar hannu mafi aminci, wadda aka tsara bisa sirri.
safeDescription: SafeMobile shirin bincikenmu ne da ke nazarin ƙwarewar tsaron Android mai mutunta sirri. Muna nazarin bayanan haɗarin na'ura, wayar da kan tsaron kuɗi, da basirar da ke aiki a cikin na'ura.
contactTitle: Mu gina wani abu mai ma'ana tare.
contactDescription: Kana da tambaya game da manhajojinmu, bincike ko kamfaninmu? Aiko mana da saƙo. Za mu yi farin cikin jin daga gare ka.
notFoundDescription: Wataƙila an matsar da shafin da kake nema ko kuma babu shi yanzu.
researchTitle: Bincike da ci gaba kan AI, sirri da tsaro
researchDescription: Muna bincika yadda tsarin basira da injiniyanci mai mutunta sirri za su iya samar da ƙwarewar dijital mafi aminci da amfani.
quizTitle: Wace manhaja ce ta dace da kai?
quizIntro: Zaɓi abin da kake son yi, za mu nuna maka manhajar da ta dace.
quizDeveloper: Ina buƙatar shiga Developer Options cikin sauri
quizKids: Ina son manhajar zane mai ƙirƙira ga yara
quizResultPdf: VibeSync All in ONE PDF Suite wuri ne mai kyau don farawa.
quizResultDeveloper: Developer Options Shortcut na ba da saurin shiga Android Developer Options.
quizResultKids: Kids Drawing Studio na ba yara wuri mai daɗi don zane.
quizHint: Zaɓi abu ɗaya don ganin shawara.
heroImageAlt: Abokan aiki suna tattaunawa a kusa da tebur a wurin aiki na zamani mai haske
legalNotice: An rubuta wannan yarjejeniya da Turanci. Idan akwai wani saɓani ko rashin jituwa tsakanin sigar Turanci da kowace sigar da aka fassara, sigar Turanci ce za ta fi rinjaye.
